steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Evolutionary explanations: NVC evolved because it helped survival. Darwin argued that facial expressions evolved from useful actions (e.g. baring teeth in anger originally prepared for biting). Universal expressions suggest an evolutionary origin shared across cultures. | Key Fact: Innate explanations: NVC is biologically programmed. Evidence: Ekman's universal facial expressions; blind individuals show similar facial expressions despite never seeing them (Matsumoto & Hwang); infants smile and cry without learning. | Key Fact: Cultural explanations: NVC is learned through socialisation.
